description: WP2 (thesis_v2): can a ligand's metal-sensitivity be predicted from ligand chemistry alone? ECFP4 -> flip/no-flip, stratified 5-fold CV, retrain-under-shuffled-labels permutation null, Holm across sample sets.
data_source: MetalCytoToxDB (Krasnov et al., J. Med. Chem. 2026, 69(8), 8838)

permutation_null.reason: n=6782 > 1000; refit null is cost-prohibitive, CV AUC reported only

honest_framing.caveat: Features are ECFP4 only -- no metal input -- so a positive result is the ligand-chemistry-alone claim. The 'all_ligands' set is a secondary check whose negatives are contaminated by never-re-tested ligands; the 'multi_metal' set is the headline.
